intent: Decision: archive store backend (OCI registry vs S3/GCS vs RWX PVC) as an ADR
Compare archive stores and record ADR 0001 choosing OCI

title: chose OCI registry over S3/GCS and RWX PVC as the first archive store
why: Adopters already have registry credentials and network paths from image pulls, and the content digest gives integrity verification without extra code. RWX storage classes are missing on many clusters.
alternative: RWX PVC — rejected: not available on many clusters

title: put the store behind a small put/get/exists interface keyed by fingerprint
why: Lets S3/GCS be added later without changing fetch or run, and lets every store failure map to 'no archive' so the pod still starts.
alternative: Hard-code OCI calls in fetch — rejected: couples commands to one backend and scatters failure handling

name: ADR 0001
role: Records the archive-store choice (OCI first) and its consequences for #12, #13, #15
conditions: Changing the backend requires a superseding ADR

subject: OCI registry garbage collection
why: Untagged blobs can be deleted by registry GC, so the trainer must tag every uploaded archive with its fingerprint

subject: Registry blob-size limits
why: Some registries cap blob size; archives are hundreds of MB, so adopters may need to raise the limit
